column1: # Query actions that a handler dispatches but routing does not send to that handler.
# Columns: service, action, service it reaches instead.
# Routing only matters when a request arrives without a usable credential scope, since
# otherwise the service comes from the SigV4 scope. On that path the action name is all
# there is, and AwsQueryServiceResolver backs IamEnforcementFilter too, so an entry here
# is also authorized under the wrong namespace.
# Two kinds of entry, told apart by the third column:
#   -> sqs     The name is in no routing set, so it falls through to the sqs default.
#              Fixable by adding the name to its service's set, as #5032 did for IAM,
#              once checked that no service earlier in the chain claims it.
#   -> other   A service earlier in inferServiceFromAction's chain already owns the
#              name, so adding it to the right set changes nothing. These need the
#              Version form field to disambiguate, the way isElbClassicRequest already
#              reads it, which is a cross-service routing change of its own.
# 189 entries: 171 unrouted, 18 claimed by another service.
# Shrink this file, never grow it. Removing a line is the point; adding one needs a
# reason in the PR that adds it. AwsQueryActionRoutingParityTest fails on an entry that
# is no longer a gap, so a fix cannot leave the list stale.
